scene.name: start
scene.description:
*************************************************** ********* The Mansion of Professor Ludlow ********* *************************************************** Adapted from a D&D module by James Ward
You are on a camping trip with a large group of boy scouts. During a nighttime hike, you get separated from the rest of the group. You stumble upon a meadow. There in front of you is a large mansion. You hear an eerie plea for help coming from inside. What do you do?

choice.description: Open the front door without knocking

scene.name: no_response
scene.description: No one comes to the door and you hear nothing. A few minutes pass. Still nothing.

choice.description: Open the front door without knocking
Return to the rest of your group

scene.name: open_crates
scene.description: It takes you a really long time, but you finally open and inspect all the crates. You find nothing in them except for leaves, dust, and stray paperclips.

scene.name: sky_falls
scene.description: The sky falls on you. Game over.

scene.name: quit
scene.description: You go back to the others. They don't believe your story. You enjoy the rest of the camping trip.

scene.name: A.inside_entrance
scene.description: The double door is unlocked and opens easily. The beam of your flashlight reveals an empty hallway with a mirror at the opposite end. There are openings that lead to rooms on the left and right. The hall has inch-thick red carpeting and walnut-paneled walls. The mirror at the end runs from the floor to the twenty-foot-high ceiling and covers the forty feet of wall section on that south face of the hall. (Referee note: the mirror lifts to reveal a secret door. All first-floor walls are actually unbreakable metal.)

choice.description: Tamper with mirror at the end of the hall (to the south)
Enter the special halls (gold / mirror / silver)

scene.name: M.marbleBedroom
scene.description: The beams of your flashlights show a room with walls, floor, and ceiling of white marble. There is a bed in one corner, several dressers, and a floor-to-ceiling mirror on one wall. The bed is a huge four-poster with dust on the green satin bedspread. Four dressers hold white operating gowns and masks; bedstands hide dimes, batteries, and a gold letter opener. (Referee: under the pillow is a red plastic disc—when worn, every room lights up. If anyone lies fully on the bed, the canopy tries to suffocate them for 5 hp/round until cut away.)

scene.name: N.armorHall
scene.description: The beams of your flashlights show a room with twelve figures dressed in metal. On the opposite side of the room is another exit. The room is paneled in red oak. The twelve figures are suits of armor in two rows of six, each with an upraised sword. (Referee: if the two northernmost suits are touched, they animate and attack. There are two such rooms labeled N on the map—this is one of them.)

scene.name: O.kitchen
scene.description: The beams of your flashlights show a room with a large table and chairs, cupboards, metal sinks, a gas stove, and a huge refrigerator. The room is painted yellow. Cupboards hold canned goods; pots and pans fill another cupboard. (Referee: if the freezer is broken into, a white pudding attacks. Two such kitchen rooms exist on the map.)

choice.description: Follow the passage toward the trophy wing

scene.name: goldHall
scene.description: The beams of your flashlights reveal a short hall with gold-colored metal walls, floor, and ceiling. The hall is sixty feet east-west and twenty feet north-south, plated with thin riveted squares. (Referee: the plates are real gold worth 9 gp each.)

scene.name: mirrorHall
scene.description: The beams of your flashlights reveal a hall lined with mirrors, 140 feet long east-west. Light seems to build unnaturally each round you stand here. (Referee: every 21st melee round, stored light disintegrates the darkest target for 100 damage, then resets.)

scene.name: silverHall
scene.description: The beams of your flashlights reveal a hall with silver-colored metal walls, eighty feet long. (Referee: plates are solid silver worth 3 gp each.)

choice.description: Descend toward the annex pool (area AA)

scene.name: closets
scene.description: Rooms filled with clothing: coats, raincoats, boots—all sized for a tall man.

choice.description: Continue to the grape-juice pool room

scene.name: AA.pool
scene.description: The beams of your flashlights reveal a swimming pool filled with dark liquid. A ten-foot concrete border lets you walk around it. The liquid smells sickeningly sweet. (Referee: it is grape juice, fresh and drinkable; the pool is thirty feet deep.)

scene.name: BB.copper
scene.description: An empty room whose walls are dull copper-colored metal, forty feet square.

scene.name: CC.corridor
scene.description: An L-shaped room: paneled oak walls, grey marble floor and ceiling, wide hallway exit and another opening diagonally opposite. (Referee: two CC rooms exist; wide openings lead toward the Silver Hall and Gold Hall.)

choice.description: Descend toward the black spiral room

scene.name: DD.blackSpiral
scene.description: A room with black barn-board walls and a metal spiral staircase going up at one end. Eighty feet east-west, forty feet north-south.

scene.name: EE.sheetRoom
scene.description: A room with several objects covered by sheets—the walls are dark oak beneath foam rubber bits if you dig. (Referee: a spiral staircase of metal may be uncovered here.)

choice.description: Back to the black spiral room

scene.name: R.foamRoom
scene.description: A room filled top to bottom with small bits of foam rubber. Moving through it takes time. Underneath, surfaces are dark oak; a metal spiral staircase may lie hidden.

choice.description: Push on to the computer room

scene.name: S.computerRoom
scene.description: A huge computer fills both sides of the room; a narrow path runs between the machines. On the east side, a table holds a typewriter; above it, a television screen. (Referee: the computer answers typed questions about the house; technical answers come back in Latin.)

choice.description: Continue to the pink fiberglass bathroom

scene.name: T.pinkBathroom
scene.description: A bathroom with stool, sink, mirror, and tub. Everything is pink fiberglass; the tub bubbles. (Referee: the tub holds hydrochloric acid—dissolves anything except glass. The medicine cabinet behind the mirror is empty.)

scene.name: U.fungusLibrary
scene.description: A room filled with books on shelves, a desk, and another exit. Fungus coats surfaces five inches thick; spores cloud the air. (Referee: harmless but foul-smelling; the pile hides +4 glowing plate mail.)

scene.name: B.rat_room
scene.description: The beams of your flashlight show a room paneled in red-stained barn boards with a floor of the same substance. There is a couch in the northeast corner and an opening on the east wall. Leaves litter the floor; the couch is dusty and overstuffed. The room measures sixty feet east and west and forty feet north and south.

choice.description: Sift through the leaves on the floor.
Go through the door on the east side.
Go back to the inside entrance

scene.name: C.pink_hallway
scene.description: The beam of your flashlight shows a hall with pink walls and a floor of red marble. Clean squares mark where pictures once hung. The hall is eighty feet east-west, twenty feet north-south.

choice.description: Proceed into the room at the end of the hall (east).

scene.name: D.crate_room
scene.description: Gray painted walls, cement floor, wooden crates, leaves in piles. Two hundred empty crates; the biggest leaf piles are in the southwest alcove. Behind a big crate on the east wall, thirty feet from the north corner, is a door with a normal handle.

choice.description: Go through door behind big crate (east).
Sift through the pile of leaves on the floor.

scene.name: D.crate_room_leaves
scene.description: There are snakes in the leaves. Three four-foot rattlesnakes attack. (HP: 10,8,5; #AT: 1; damage:1-3; AC: 5; SA: Save versus death caused by poison).

scene.name: F.oak_room
scene.description: Oak-paneled room filled with rock shelves; stairs go up from the south. A partial wall divides the space; passageway on the west in the north corner; doorway farther south; another exit by the stairs on the east.

choice.description: Head south and climb the stairs.
Exit to the east using the opening at the base of the stairs.
Inspect the rocks on the shelves.
Exit to the west into the passageway at the north corner
Go back to gray storage room.

scene.name: E.crazy_man_attacks
scene.description: An incredibly old man in rags attacks with a butcher knife (HP: 7; #AT: 1; damage: 1-6; AC: 10). He will not follow you out of the room.

choice.description: If you survive or subdue him, continue searching

scene.name: E.gray_storage_room
scene.description: Gray walls, cement floor, boxes and barrels: grain alcohol, gloves, silver service, plant books, clay pots, mattress crates hiding the east door.

choice.description: Go through the door on the east side.
Go back to the room with the crates (west).

scene.name: G.passageway
scene.description: Gray walls, black marble floor, openings east and west. Medieval weapons hang in perfect condition. The hall is twenty feet by one hundred feet.

choice.description: Travel west along the hallway to the door at the end.
Go back to the oak storage room.

scene.name: F.stairway
scene.description: A creaky wooden stairway climbs from the south end of the oak-walled rock gallery. Cold air drifts from above; a landing and closed door wait at the top.

choice.description: Climb the stairs to the second floor
Go back down into the oak room

scene.name: F.rocks
scene.description: Valuable mineral samples sit on high shelves on the south wall in the corridor behind the dividing wall—no crystal samples anywhere.

scene.name: H.fur_room
scene.description: Purple furs cover walls, ceiling, and floor. A metal spiral staircase in the northwest corner is painted purple enamel. Eighty by sixty feet.

scene.name: H.inspect_wall
scene.description: Tapping shows a hollow; a section of fur slides aside to reveal a normal door.

scene.name: H.spiral_staircase
scene.description: The purple metal spiral is steep. At the top, air grows warm and furred—you emerge in another fur-lined chamber.

choice.description: Explore the fur-lined room at the top

scene.name: I.statue_room
scene.description: Green wood paneling; fifteen statues—Vikings, amazons, knights, and five Wisconsin State Patrol figures with nightsticks. Sixty by forty feet. (Referee: all are petrified people, aware but unable to communicate.)

choice.description: Attempt to speak with the statues
Slip back through the secret door

scene.name: I.talk_to_statues
scene.description: They make grunting noises back to you.

scene.name: I.attack_statues
scene.description: Your blows clang on stone. The module notes these are living people, petrified—unable to respond.

choice.description: Stop and look for another way to help them

scene.name: A.mirror
scene.description: You find that the mirror lifts easily. There is a secret door behind it.

scene.name: P.plant_room
scene.description: Plants in glowing purple liquid fill tanks wall to wall; the path across is about eighty feet. Thorny brambles block the secret door until cut—cutting risks stirges.

choice.description: Inspect or cut the plants (risk attacks)
Pick your way carefully toward the far exit

scene.name: P.inspect_plants
scene.description: Seven stirges burst from the foliage when it is disturbed. (HP 5 each; #AT 1; damage 1-3; AC 8; blood drain.)

choice.description: Fight or flee back toward the secret door

scene.name: J.Bathroom
scene.description: Black marble bathroom: sink, mirror, stool, tub. Water shuts off before overflow. Hinges suggest a missing door. Forty-foot square plus a tub hall.

choice.description: Examine the sink and turn on the water
Return to the oak rock gallery

scene.name: J.medicine_cabinet
scene.description: Two plastic bottles: ten green pills; twenty pink pills.

choice.description: Swallow one of the green pills
Swallow one of the pink pills

scene.name: B.rat_attack
scene.description: Three giant rats boil out from under the couch. (HP 4,3,2; #AT 1; damage 1-3; AC 7; 5% disease on bite.)

scene.name: B.key
scene.description: You find a golden key under the pile of leaves. (Keep an inventory of found items in play.)

scene.name: L.upStaircase
scene.description: Rat fur covers walls, floor, and ceiling; lice and rot smell. A black-enameled metal spiral rises in the northwest corner. Sixty feet square beneath the fur.

scene.name: K.trophyRoom
scene.description: Stuffed felines on brown walls; rifles and shotguns in a north-wall cabinet with shells in the drawer. Forty by sixty feet. Exits east and west.

choice.description: Proceed west toward the rat-fur spiral room

scene.name: K.fireRifle
scene.description: You heft a heavy rifle. Without a gunnery merit badge, working the levers is guesswork—metal slams into your shoulder (1–4 bruising) and the shot goes wide. The trophies seem to watch in the dim light.

scene.name: X.spiralStaircase
scene.description: Thick furs—zebra, lion, leopard, polar bear—worth serious treasure. A side exit leads off the landing. Four giant centipedes may appear when several people step on the furs.

choice.description: Descend toward the purple fur chamber

scene.name: VII.chunksRoom
scene.description: Metal chunks litter the floor; three fake oak doors refuse to open. Chunks rain from the ceiling each round after entry. (Referee: 3–18 chunks per round, 15% hit chance each, 1–6 damage.)

choice.description: Search for another exit among the scrap
Retreat down the stairs to the oak room

scene.name: Floor2.I
scene.description: Yellow carpet; huge spiderwebs on the ceiling. Thirty feet square; stairs ascend along the west wall. Three giant spiders wait above.

choice.description: Press on to the next chamber

scene.name: Floor2.II
scene.description: Nine benches of glassware, acids, and green flammable jelly. Another exit hides a spiral staircase down.

choice.description: Press on to the next chamber

scene.name: Floor2.III
scene.description: A barbed devil is chained in a silver circle, pleading in foreign tongues. Boxes underfoot hold a ring of one wish and dust of disappearance.

choice.description: Press on to the next chamber

scene.name: Floor2.IV
scene.description: Bare room: dazzling lights and deafening sound when active. Sunburn and hearing loss if you linger.

choice.description: Press on to the next chamber

scene.name: Floor2.V
scene.description: A Persian rug hides a central pit. Stay near the walls or fall fifteen feet.

choice.description: Press on to the next chamber

scene.name: Floor2.VI
scene.description: Super-magnet in the ceiling seizes metal; a glass plate on the floor covers the off switch.

choice.description: Press on to the next chamber

scene.name: Floor2.VIII
scene.description: Bare room, stairs down on a south landing; flower-scented gas weakens Strength. Secret door on the landing opens if light shines one minute.

choice.description: Press on to the next chamber

scene.name: Floor2.IX
scene.description: Electronics lab: chips, tubes, solder, barrels of wire. Ascending stairs in the east corner lead up.

choice.description: Press on to the next chamber

scene.name: Floor2.X
scene.description: Bunk beds, dressers, desk strewn with cloning notes; secret drawer holds poison gas and a photo of Ludlow with a giant robot.

choice.description: Press on to the next chamber

scene.name: Floor2.XI
scene.description: Shooting gallery with air rifles, pellets, and targets—disturbing the guns may release a lion.

choice.description: Press on to the next chamber

scene.name: Floor2.XII
scene.description: Satin cushions; a winged woman sleeps—an Erinyes who feigns kindness if freed.

choice.description: Press on to the next chamber

scene.name: Floor2.XIII
scene.description: Strong purple light; intense heat heals damage but burns if you stay past ten minutes.

choice.description: Press on to the next chamber

scene.name: Floor2.XIV
scene.description: A hill giant shambles in a cage; rags hide cash, a laser pistol, and a bloody knife.

choice.description: Press on to the next chamber

scene.name: Floor2.XV
scene.description: Locked cabinets of pure elements and chemicals—dangerous if mishandled.

choice.description: Press on to the next chamber

scene.name: Floor2.XVI
scene.description: Shower room with ten stalls; water drains to a central grate.

choice.description: Press on to the next chamber

scene.name: Floor2.XVII
scene.description: Pipe storage and threading tools—enough stock to improvise clubs.

choice.description: Press on to the next chamber

scene.name: Floor2.XXI
scene.description: Torture devices: rack, iron maiden, branding irons with 'L'. Good campers should find it revolting.

choice.description: Press on to the next chamber

scene.name: Floor2.XXII
scene.description: Bright theater: projector, screen, film canister 'Laser Rifle Care by Ludlow'—ropers drop from the ceiling mid-film.

choice.description: Press on to the next chamber

scene.name: Floor2.XXIII
scene.description: Assembly benches for laser-rifle parts; a completed prototype may lie under Bench Eight.

scene.name: Floor3.X
scene.description: Glowing pillar ten feet wide; something moves inside the light. (Referee: breaking the beam frees a hell hound that pursues you.)

scene.name: Floor3.XI
scene.description: Spiral staircase; a leather sack of ball bearings hovers magnetically in the center.

scene.name: Floor3.XII
scene.description: Microscope lab: twenty-two benches of slides and specimens.

scene.name: Floor3.XIII
scene.description: Purple glow; dried bones in a corner; ultraviolet heat sears if you linger.

scene.name: Floor3.XIV
scene.description: Robot parts and tentacles on benches; a dormant robot waits in the corner. (Referee: touching its left shoulder with metal activates it.)

scene.name: Floor3.XV
scene.description: Everything is coated in red plastic that sticks to your feet every tenth step until you sweat free.

choice.description: Confront the source of the recording

scene.name: storyFinale
scene.description: Deep in the mansion you find Professor Ludlow's control nook: a tape recorder on loop, wired to the front doors—there never was a prisoner, only bait. You smash the device, gather your nerve, and run for the exit before the house can answer. The night air never tasted so sweet. (Referee: the 'Help!' was a recording, as noted in the module.)

scene.name: J.turnOnWater
scene.description: The water runs clear and shuts off before overflow.

scene.name: J.takeGreenPill
scene.description: Your heart hammers—reflexes doubled for three melee rounds (module).

scene.name: J.takePinkPill
scene.description: Warmth spreads; up to ten hit points restored per pink pill.

scene.name: Q.skeleton_room
scene.description: Stone walls; a child's skeleton lies in pieces; a golden ring glints on a finger. (Referee: skull near body animates the skeleton; ring holds three wishes after the skeleton is destroyed.)

choice.description: Follow the farther exit toward foam and machinery
